semantic.justification: S3HW1E HTML64: native anchor/wrap prerequisites for the HTML first-table context now use real SwFormatAnchor/SwFormatSurround items, original RndStdIds/TextContentAnchorType identities, RES_ANCHOR114 and RES_SURROUND111, actual module-global static defaults, document-pool registration and typed inherited frame getters. Anchor owns an optional real copied SwPosition, is nonshareable, allocates a new uint32 order on construction/copy or changed assignment, excludes order from equality, detaches content binding for paragraph/fly anchors and preserves original raw type/page setter behavior. SwPosition now has the original copy form and clone preserves raw node/content bindings, owner category and affinity instead of reattaching a node-only anchor to text. Surround retains PARALLEL/three-false defaults and independent flags through real copy/equality/pooling. SwFormat releases its owned attribute-set member after dependent reparenting and before base modify teardown; this is needed for real owning anchor-position destruction. This is native state/default/position ownership, not completed UNO frame/property conversion, localized presentation, serialized anchor-position restoration, special-frame registry/factory/sections or fly layout. Those absent services are not simulated or certified. HTML first-cell/recursive production/materialization/layout, RTF direction and final format/UI audit remain unverified. Save/open/autosave/recovery deviations are unchanged. HTML64 follow-up preserves the actual engaged optional-position identity on anchor copy assignment, using native raw SwPosition value assignment, and preserves SetAnchor destroy-before-copy replacement order. WRITER345 records the potential source self-alias hazard without asserting a defined compiled result or native reachability. RTF99. Retains native character anchors at the insertion coordinate using the existing browser content-index affinity.
